tagline: 체대와 물리치료학과 수시 지원 가능성을 빠르게 가늠하는 모의 분석 도구.

posts.title: Morning Pages Before Email
posts.excerpt: Ten minutes of handwriting changed how I start the workday.
posts.author: Mihyun Park
posts.body:
I do not check my phone until the notebook is full—usually half a page, never more.

Some days it is grocery lists and stray worries. Other days a single sentence is enough: today, finish the small thing first.

Posting it here is optional; the blog is the public layer on top of a private habit.

posts.title: My Remote Desk Setup in 2026
posts.excerpt: Chair, light, and one rule: cables where I cannot see them.
posts.author: Mihyun Park
posts.body:
The monitor sits at arm's length. The keyboard is quiet enough for calls. Everything else is negotiable.

I used to chase perfect gear. Now I chase a clear surface at 5 p.m.

posts.title: Why I Use Four Categories on This Blog
posts.excerpt: Fewer labels make archiving easier—for me and for readers.
posts.author: Mihyun Park
posts.body:
Life, Work, Travel, Food. That is the whole map. If a post does not fit, I edit the post—not the taxonomy.

On the blog page you can filter by chip. It is the same list, just narrowed.

posts.title: Weeknight Pasta Without a Recipe
posts.excerpt: Olive oil, garlic, whatever green thing is in the fridge.
posts.author: Mihyun Park
posts.body:
Boil water first. Always. The sauce can wait thirty seconds; the pasta cannot.

I write food posts when I want a record of what comfort tasted like that year.

posts.title: A Rainy Hour at the Museum
posts.excerpt: Fewer photos, more wall text than usual.
posts.author: Mihyun Park
posts.body:
Bad weather is good for slow looking. I left with one note in my phone and no gift-shop bag.

Not every visit needs a post—but this one did.

posts.title: Writing in Public, Editing in Private
posts.excerpt: Drafts are messy; published posts owe you clarity.
posts.author: Mihyun Park
posts.body:
I keep fragments in notes apps and polish only what ships on The Daily Draft.

Readers see the finished post template—title, date, category, body—not the four deleted paragraphs.

posts.title: One Bag for a Long Weekend
posts.excerpt: If it does not fit, it does not go.
posts.author: Mihyun Park
posts.body:
Travel posts on this blog are short on logistics and long on what surprised me.

This trip: one jacket, no checked bag, wrong shoes anyway.

posts.title: Hello, This Is My Blog
posts.excerpt: What The Daily Draft is and how often I plan to post.
posts.author: Mihyun Park
posts.body:
Welcome. You are on the home page, the blog list, or a single post—same site, three views.

I will publish when there is something worth keeping, not on a schedule I cannot keep.

Thanks for reading.
